rows.summary: CRWV's EBITDA collapsed from +$742M in Q4'25 to -$144M in Q1'26 — a staggering -$886M swing in a single quarter. rows.what_changed: EBITDA was positive and growing through Q4'25 ($583M→$704M→$742M) before completely reversing to -$144M in Q1'26. Operating income also deteriorated from +$52M in Q3'25 to -$144M in Q1'26.
rows.why_now: Q1'26 earnings released May 7, 2026 showed this dramatic reversal from prior quarters where EBITDA was positive and growing.

rows.summary: CRWV's revenue grew 130% YoY and 32% QoQ to $2.08B, yet operating losses widened to -$144M and net losses to -$740M. Despite ~65% gross margins, operating expenses are growing faster than revenue, destroying any path to profitability. The company is 'growing into losses' — a dangerous pattern for a high-beta (2.87) stock.
rows.what_changed: Previous quarters showed improving operating income (Q2'25: $19M, Q3'25: $52M) before collapsing to -$89M in Q4'25 and -$144M in Q1'26. The growth story is now a cash-burn story.
rows.why_now: Q1'26 results revealed that massive revenue growth is not translating to operating leverage — in fact, margins are compressing as the company scales.
